africa/alexandria.description: Alexandria is a major city in Egypt. Lying at the western edge of the Nile River Delta, it extends about 40 km (25 mi) along the country's northern coast.

africa/anse-lazio.description: Anse Lazio is a beach situated in the northwest of Praslin Island, Seychelles, considered by Lonely Planet to be the "best beach on Praslin", and one of the "best in the archipelago".

africa/cairo.description: Cairo is the capital and largest city of Egypt and the Cairo Governorate. It is home to more than 9.8 million people.

africa/cape-town.description: Cape Town is the legislative capital of South Africa. It is the country's oldest city and the seat of the Parliament of South Africa.
africa/cape-town.credit: Der Berzerker from Washington, DC, USA

africa/ile-aux-cerfs.description: Île aux Cerfs is a privately owned island near the east coast of Mauritius in the Flacq District. The island contains Ile Aux Cerfs Golf Club.

africa/johannesburg.description: Johannesburg, colloquially known as Jozi, Joburg, or "the City of Gold", is the capital city of the province of Gauteng and the largest city in South Africa.

africa/knysna.description: Knysna is a coastal town with 76,150 inhabitants in the Western Cape province of South Africa. It is one of the destinations in the lush Garden Route region.

africa/la-digue-island.description: La Digue is the third most populated island of the Seychelles, and fourth largest by land area, lying east of Praslin and west of Felicite Island.

africa/lake-naivasha.description: Lake Naivasha is a freshwater lake in Kenya, outside the town of Naivasha in Nakuru County, north west of Nairobi in the Great Rift Valley.

africa/luxor.description: Luxor is a city in Upper Egypt. Luxor had a population of 284,952 in 2023, with an area of 43.0 km2 (16.6 sq mi) and is the capital of the Luxor Governorate.

africa/mahe-island.description: Mahé is the largest island of Seychelles, with an area of 157.3 square kilometres (60.7 sq mi), lying in the northeast of the Seychellois nation in the Somali Sea part of the Indian Ocean.

africa/nairobi.description: Nairobi is the capital and largest city of Kenya, located in the south-central part of the country.

africa/oudtshoorn.description: Oudtshoorn is a town in the Western Cape province of South Africa, located between the Swartberg mountains to the north and the Outeniqua Mountains to the south.

africa/port-louis.description: Port Louis is the capital and most populous city of Mauritius, mainly located in the Port Louis District, with a small western part in the Black River District. Port Louis is the country's financial and political centre.

africa/praslin-island.description: Praslin is the second largest island (38.5 km2) of the Inner Seychelles, lying 44 km (27 mi) northeast of Mahé.

africa/vallee-de-mai.description: Vallée de Mai Nature Reserve is a nature park on the island of Praslin in the Seychelles.

east-asia/beijing.description: Beijing, previously romanized as Peking, is the capital city of China.

east-asia/darchen.description: Kangsa Village, poetically known as Darchen, Tarchan or Taqin, is a former Bhutanese enclave, currently held by the People's Republic of China and the seat of the Parga Township, Purang County, Tibet Autonomous Region, C

east-asia/golgulsa.description: Golgulsa is a Buddhist temple in Gyeongju, South Korea. It dates to the Silla period.

east-asia/jeonju.description: Jeonju is the capital and largest city of the province of Jeonbuk, South Korea. It is both urban and rural due to the closeness of Wanju County which almost entirely surrounds Jeonju.

east-asia/kathmandu.description: Kathmandu is the capital and largest city of Nepal, situated in the central part of the country within the Kathmandu Valley. The city is in Kathmandu District.

east-asia/kyoto.description: Kyoto, officially Kyoto City , is the capital city of Kyoto Prefecture in the Kansai region of Japan's largest and most populous island of Honshu.

east-asia/lake-mansarovar.description: Lake Manasarovar, also called Mapam Yumtso, is a high altitude freshwater lake near Mount Kailash in Burang County, Ngari Prefecture, Tibet Autonomous Region, China.

east-asia/longji-rice-terraces.description: The Longji Rice Terraces, also called the Longsheng Rice Terraces, are located in the town of Longji in Longsheng Various Nationalities Autonomous County, about 100 kilometres (62 mi) from Guilin, China.

east-asia/macau.description: Macau or Macao is a special administrative region of China. It consists of the Macau Peninsula, the islands of Taipa and Coloane, the Cotai reclamation zone between Taipa and Coloane, and several smaller islets.

east-asia/mt-fuji.description: Mount Fuji  is an active stratovolcano located on the Japanese island of Honshu, with a summit elevation of 3,776.24 m.

east-asia/osaka.description: Osaka  is a designated city in the Kansai region of Honshu in Japan.

east-asia/shanghai.description: Shanghai is a provincial-level direct-administered municipality in China.

east-asia/syabrubesi.description: Syaphru or Syabru is a village development committee in Rasuwa District in the Bagmati Zone of northern Nepal. As of the 2021 Nepal census, it had a population of 450 people.

east-asia/tokyo.description: Tokyo, officially the Tokyo Metropolis, is the capital and most populous city of Japan. The population of the city proper was over 14 million as of 2023.

east-asia/tongli.description: Tongli, alternately Tong-Li is a town in Wujiang district, on the outskirts of Suzhou, Jiangsu province. It is known for a system of canals, it has been given the nickname "Venice of the East".

east-asia/wuzhen.description: Wuzhen is a historic scenic town, part of Tongxiang, located in the north of Zhejiang Province, China. It was primarily built in the 7th century during the Tang dynasty.

east-asia/xian.description: Xi'an is the capital of the Chinese province of Shaanxi.

east-asia/xitang.description: Xitang, formerly known as Xietang, Pingtang and Xutang, is a historic town in Jiashan County, Zhejiang, China.

east-asia/yangshuo.description: Yangshuo County is a county under the jurisdiction of Guilin City, in the northeast of Guangxi, China. Its seat is located in the town of Yangshuo.

east-asia/zhouzhuang.description: Zhouzhuang is a water town known for its canals in Jiangsu province, China. It is located within the administrative area of Kunshan, 30 km southeast of the city centre of Suzhou.

east-asia/zhujiajiao.description: Zhujiajiao is an ancient town located in the Qingpu District of Shanghai. The population of Zhujiajiao is 95,536.

eurasia-cis/almaty.description: Almaty is the most populous city in Kazakhstan, with more than two million residents.

eurasia-cis/baku.description: Baku is the capital and largest city of Azerbaijan, as well as the largest city on the Caspian Sea and in the Caucasus region.

eurasia-cis/batumi.description: Batumi is the second-largest city of Georgia and the capital of Georgia's Autonomous Republic of Adjara, located on the coast of the Black Sea in Georgia's southwest, 20 kilometres (12 mi) north of the border with Turkey
eurasia-cis/batumi.credit: Commander, U.S. Naval Forces Europe-Africa/U.S. 6th Fleet

eurasia-cis/bishkek.description: Bishkek, formerly known as Pishpek, and then Frunze (1926–1991), is the capital and largest city of Kyrgyzstan, and the capital of the Chüy Region.

eurasia-cis/kok-tobe.description: Köktöbe or Koktyube is a hill in Kazakhstan's largest city and former capital, Almaty. At 1,100 meters above sea level, it is regarded as emblematic of the city and one of its main landmarks.

eurasia-cis/samarkand.description: Samarkand is a major city in south-eastern Uzbekistan.
eurasia-cis/samarkand.credit: Registan_-_Gusjer.jpg: Gustavo Jeronimo from Aranjuez, Spain derivative work: Mr

eurasia-cis/tbilisi.description: Tbilisi is the capital and largest city of Georgia, located on the banks of the Kura River. With more than 1.3 million inhabitants, it contains almost one third of the country's population.

eurasia-cis/uplistsikhe.description: Uplistsikhe is an ancient rock-hewn town in eastern Georgia, some 10 kilometers east of the town of Gori, Shida Kartli.
eurasia-cis/uplistsikhe.credit: This Photo was taken by Supanut Arunoprayote. Feel free to use any of my images,

europe/aalborg.description: Aalborg or Ålborg is Denmark's fourth largest city with a population of 119,862 in the town proper and an urban population of 143,598.

europe/aarhus.description: Aarhus is the second-largest city in Denmark and the seat of Aarhus Municipality. It is located on the eastern shore of Jutland in the Kattegat sea and approximately 187 kilometres (116 mi) northwest of Copenhagen.

europe/aberdeen.description: Aberdeen is a port city in North East Scotland, and is the third most populous Scottish city.

europe/abisko.description: Abisko is a village in Sápmi (Lapland), in northern Sweden, roughly 200 km north of the Arctic Circle, and near Abisko National Park, located 4 km west of the village. It had 85 inhabitants as of 2005.

europe/akureyri.description: Akureyri is a town in northern Iceland, the country's fifth most populous municipality and the largest outside the Capital Region.

europe/albufeira.description: Albufeira, officially the City of Albufeira, is a city and municipality of Faro District in the Algarve region of southern Portugal. The population in 2021 was 44,158, in an area of 140.66 square kilometres.

europe/alesund.description: Ålesund is a town in Møre og Romsdal county, Norway. The town is the administrative centre of Ålesund Municipality.

europe/amalfi.description: Amalfi is a town and comune in the province of Salerno, in the region of Campania, Italy, on the Gulf of Salerno.
europe/amalfi.credit: No machine-readable author provided. Sudodana2048 assumed (based on copyright cl

europe/amsterdam.description: Amsterdam is the capital and largest city of the Netherlands. As of 1 January 2026, it had a population of 941,873 within the city proper, 1,457,018 in the urban area and 2,480,394 in the metropolitan area.

europe/antwerp.description: Antwerp is a city and a municipality in the Flemish Region of Belgium. It is the capital and largest city of Antwerp Province, and the third-largest municipality in Belgium by area at 208.22 km2 (80.39 sq mi).

europe/athens.description: Athens is the capital and largest city of Greece. A significant coastal urban area in the Mediterranean, Athens is also the capital of the Attica region and is the southernmost capital on the European mainland.

europe/avignon.description: Avignon is the prefecture of the Vaucluse department in the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region of southern France.

europe/balzers.description: Balzers is a municipality and village located in southern Liechtenstein. In 2024, the village had a population of 4,806. The main part of the village is situated along the east bank of the Rhine.

europe/barcelona.description: Barcelona is a city on the northeastern coast of Spain. It is the capital and largest city of the autonomous community of Catalonia, as well as the second-most populous municipality of Spain after Madrid.

europe/bari.description: Bari is the capital city of the Metropolitan City of Bari and of the region of Apulia, on the Adriatic Sea in southern Italy. It is one of the most important economic centres of mainland southern Italy.

europe/belfast.description: Belfast is the capital, largest city and main port of Northern Ireland. It stands on the banks of the river Lagan, and is connected to the open sea through Belfast Lough and the North Channel.

europe/bergen.description: Bergen is a city and municipality in the Vestland county on the west coast of Norway. Bergen is the second-largest city in Norway after the capital, Oslo.

europe/berlin.description: Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany. With 3.7 million inhabitants, it has the highest population within its city limits of any city in the European Union (EU).
europe/berlin.credit: File:Museumsinsel Berlin Juli 2021 1 (cropped).jpg: Kasa Fue derivative work: Ge

europe/bern.description: Bern, or Berne, is the de facto capital of Switzerland, referred to as the "federal city".

europe/billund.description: Billund is a town in Jutland, Denmark. With a population of 7,446, Billund is the second largest town in Billund Municipality, behind the municipal seat of Grindsted.

europe/birmingham.description: Birmingham is a city and metropolitan borough in the centre of the West Midlands region of England.

europe/bologna.description: Bologna is the capital and largest city of the Emilia-Romagna region in northern Italy. It is the seventh most populous city in Italy, with 391,473 inhabitants from 150 different nationalities.

europe/bordeaux.description: Bordeaux is a city on the river Garonne in the Gironde department, southwestern France. A port city, it is the capital of the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region, as well as the prefecture of the Gironde department.

europe/bristol.description: Bristol is a city and ceremonial county in South West England. It is on the River Avon, and bordered by Gloucestershire to the north and Somerset to the south, with a short coastline on the Bristol Channel to the west.

europe/bruges.description: Bruges is the capital and largest city of the province of West Flanders, in the Flemish Region of Belgium. It is located in the northwest of the country, and is the sixth most populous city in Belgium.

europe/brussels.description: Brussels, officially the Brussels-Capital Region, is a region of Belgium comprising 19 municipalities, including the City of Brussels, which is the capital of Belgium.

europe/budapest.description: Budapest is the capital and largest city of Hungary.

europe/cambridge.description: Cambridge is a city and non-metropolitan district in the county of Cambridgeshire, England. It is the county town of Cambridgeshire and is located on the River Cam, 55 miles (89 km) north of London.

europe/cannes.description: Cannes is a resort city located on the French Riviera.

europe/capri.description: Capri is an island located in the Tyrrhenian Sea off the Sorrento Peninsula, on the south side of the Gulf of Naples in the Campania region of Italy.

europe/cardiff.description: Cardiff is the capital and largest city of Wales. Cardiff had a population of 381,516 in 2025 and forms a principal area officially known as the City and County of Cardiff.
europe/cardiff.credit: grahamwell / Graham profile at Flickr website

europe/cascais.description: Cascais is a town and municipality in the Lisbon District of Portugal, located on the Estoril Coast. The municipality has a total of 214,158 inhabitants in an area of 97.40 km2.

europe/catania.description: Catania is the second-largest city in the autonomous island region of Sicily in Italy, after Palermo, both by area and by population.

europe/cesky-krumlov.description: Český Krumlov is a town in the South Bohemian Region of the Czech Republic. It has about 13,000 inhabitants. The town is located on the Vltava River in the Bohemian Forest Foothills.

europe/chamonix.description: Chamonix-Mont-Blanc, more commonly known simply as Chamonix, is a commune in the Haute-Savoie department in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region in southeastern France. It hosted the first Winter Olympics, held in 1924.

europe/cinque-terre.description: The Cinque Terre is a coastal area within Liguria, in the northwest of Italy. It lies in the west of La Spezia Province, and comprises five villages: Monterosso al Mare, Vernazza, Corniglia, Manarola and Riomaggiore.

europe/clervaux.description: Clervaux is a commune and town in northern Luxembourg, situated in the canton of the same name.

europe/cliffs-of-moher.description: The Cliffs of Moher are sea cliffs located at the southwestern edge of the Burren region in County Clare, Ireland. They run for about 14 kilometres.

europe/clonmacnoise.description: Clonmacnoise or Clonmacnois is a ruined monastery in County Offaly in Ireland on the River Shannon south of Athlone, founded in 544 by Saint Ciarán, from Rathcroghan, County Roscommon.

europe/coimbra.description: Coimbra, officially the City of Coimbra, is a city and a municipality in Portugal. The population of the municipality at the 2021 census was 140,796, in an area of around 319.40 square kilometres (123.3 sq mi).

europe/colmar.description: Colmar is a city and commune in the Haut-Rhin department and Alsace region of north-eastern France.

europe/cologne.description: Cologne is the fourth-most populous city of Germany and the largest city of the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia with over one million inhabitants in the city proper and over 3.1 million people in the Cologne Bonn

europe/copenhagen.description: Copenhagen is the capital and most populous city of Denmark, with an urban population of 1.4 million. The city is situated mainly on the island of Zealand (Sjælland), with a smaller part on the island of Amager.

europe/cordoba.description: Córdoba, or sometimes Cordova, is a city in Andalusia, Spain, and the capital of the province of Córdoba. With a population of 324,902 as of 2024, it is the 12th-largest city in Spain and the 3rd-largest in Andalusia.

europe/corfu.description: Corfu or Kerkyra is one of the Ionian Islands in western Greece, and the northernmost island on Greece's west coast except for its satellite Diapontian Islands, which are also the westernmost point of all Greece.

europe/cork.description: Cork is the second-largest city in the Republic of Ireland, the county town of County Cork, the largest city in the province of Munster and the third-largest on the island of Ireland.

europe/debrecen.description: Debrecen is Hungary's second-largest city, after Budapest, the regional centre of the Northern Great Plain region and the seat of Hajdú-Bihar County.

europe/delft.description: Delft is a city and municipality in the province of South Holland, Netherlands. It is located between Rotterdam, to the southeast, and The Hague, to the northwest.

europe/delphi.description: Delphi, in legend previously called Pytho (Πυθώ), was an ancient sacred precinct in central Greece.

europe/dresden.description: Dresden is the capital city of the German state of Saxony and its second most populous city after Leipzig.

europe/dublin.description: Dublin is the capital and largest city of Ireland.

europe/dundee.description:
Dundee is the fourth-largest city in Scotland. The 2020 mid-year population estimate for the locality was 
148,210.

europe/dusseldorf.description: Düsseldorf is the capital city of North Rhine-Westphalia, the most populous state of Germany.

europe/echternach.description: Echternach is a commune with city status in the canton of Echternach, in eastern Luxembourg. Echternach lies near the border with Germany, and is the oldest town in Luxembourg.

europe/eindhoven.description: Eindhoven is a city and municipality in the Netherlands. It is the largest city in the southern province of North Brabant, and is located in the Dutch part of the Campine natural region.

europe/engelberg.description: Engelberg is a village resort and a municipality in the canton of Obwalden in Switzerland.

europe/evora.description: Évora, officially the Most Noble and Ever Loyal City of Évora, is a city and a municipality in Portugal. It has 53,591 inhabitants (2021), in an area of 1,307.08 square kilometers (504.67 mi2).

europe/faro.description: Faro, officially the City of Faro, is a city and a municipality in southern Portugal. It is the capital of both the Algarve region and the Faro District, as well as the southernmost city on the Portuguese mainland.

europe/flam.description: Flåm is a village in the Flåmsdalen valley which is located at the inner end of the Aurlandsfjorden, a branch of Sognefjorden. The village is located in Aurland Municipality in Vestland county, Norway.

europe/florence.description: Florence is the capital and most populous city of the Italian region of Tuscany, and, as of 2026, with a population of 361,625, the 8th most populous city in the country.

europe/frankfurt.description: Frankfurt am Main, usually shortened to Frankfurt, is the most populous city in the German state of Hesse. Its 778,589 inhabitants as of 2025 make it the fifth-most populous city in Germany.

europe/freiburg.description: Freiburg im Breisgau, usually shortened to Freiburg, is the fourth-largest city in the German state of Baden-Württemberg after Stuttgart, Mannheim and Karlsruhe.

europe/funchal.description: Funchal, officially the City of Funchal, is the capital, largest city and a municipality in Portugal's Autonomous Region of Madeira, bordered by the Atlantic Ocean.

europe/galway.description: Galway is a city in County Galway. It lies on the River Corrib between Lough Corrib and Galway Bay.

europe/gdansk.description: Gdańsk, historically known in English as Danzig, is a city on the Baltic coast of northern Poland, and the capital of the Pomeranian Voivodeship.

europe/geiranger.description: Geiranger is a small tourist village in Sunnmøre region of Møre og Romsdal county in the western part of Norway.

europe/geneva.description: Geneva is the second-most populous city in Switzerland and the most populous in French-speaking Romandy.

europe/ghent.description: Ghent is a city and a municipality in the East Flanders province of the Flemish Region of Belgium. It is the capital and largest city of the province and the third largest in the country, after Brussels and Antwerp.

europe/giethoorn.description: Giethoorn is a village in the province of Overijssel, Netherlands, with a population of 2,795 in 2020. It is located in the municipality of Steenwijkerland, about 5 km (3.1 mi) southwest of Steenwijk.

europe/glasgow.description: Glasgow is the most populous city in Scotland, located on the banks of the River Clyde in west central Scotland.

europe/golden-circle.description: The Golden Circle is a tourist route in southwest Iceland.
europe/golden-circle.credit: No machine-readable author provided. Tmuehlbacher assumed (based on copyright cl

europe/gothenburg.description: Gothenburg is the second-largest city in Sweden, after the capital Stockholm, and the fifth-largest in the Nordic countries.

europe/granada.description: Granada is the capital city of the province of Granada, in the autonomous community of Andalusia, Spain.

europe/graz.description: Graz is the capital of the Austrian state of Styria and the second-largest city in Austria, after Vienna.

europe/grindelwald.description: Grindelwald is a village and municipality in the Interlaken-Oberhasli administrative district in the canton of Berne.

europe/grossglockner.description: The Großglockner, or just Glockner, is, at 3,798 metres above the Adriatic (12,461 ft), the highest mountain in Austria and highest mountain in the Alps east of the Brenner Pass.

europe/haarlem.description: Haarlem is a city and municipality in the Netherlands. It is the capital of the province of North Holland.

europe/hallstatt.description: Hallstatt is a small town in the Gmunden District of the Austrian state of Upper Austria.

europe/hamburg.description: Hamburg, officially the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg, is the second-largest city in Germany after Berlin and sixth-largest city in the European Union, with a population of over 1.9 million.

europe/hanover.description: Hanover is the capital and largest city of the German state of Lower Saxony.

europe/heidelberg.description: Heidelberg is the fifth-largest city in the German state of Baden-Württemberg, and with a population of about 163,000, of which roughly a quarter consists of students, it is Germany's 51st-largest city.

europe/helsinki.description: Helsinki, until about 1930 known in English by its Swedish name of Helsingfors, is the capital and most populous city in Finland.

europe/heviz.description: Hévíz is a spa town in Zala County, Hungary, about 8 kilometres from the city of Keszthely.

europe/innsbruck.description: Innsbruck is the capital of the Austrian state of Tyrol and the fifth-largest city in Austria.

europe/interlaken.description: Interlaken is a Swiss town and municipality in the Interlaken-Oberhasli administrative district in the canton of Bern.

europe/inverness.description: Inverness is a city in the Scottish Highlands in the north of Scotland.

europe/ivalo.description: Ivalo is a village in the municipality of Inari, Lapland, Finland, located on the Ivalo River 20 kilometres (12 mi) south of Lake Inari in the Arctic Circle.

europe/jokulsarlon.description: Jökulsárlón is a large glacial lake in the southern part of Vatnajökull National Park, Iceland.

europe/jukkasjarvi.description: Jukkasjärvi is a locality situated in Kiruna Municipality, Norrbotten County, Sweden with 548 inhabitants in 2010. It is situated at 321 meters elevation.

europe/jungfraujoch.description: The Jungfraujoch is a saddle connecting two major 4000ers of the Bernese Alps: the Jungfrau and the Mönch.

europe/karlovy-vary.description: Karlovy Vary is a spa city in the Karlovy Vary Region of the Czech Republic. It has about 49,000 inhabitants. It is located at the confluence of the Ohře and Teplá rivers.

europe/katowice.description: Katowice is the capital city of the Silesian Voivodeship in southern Poland and the central city of the Katowice urban area.

europe/keflavik.description: Keflavík is a town in the Reykjanes region in southwest Iceland. It is included in the municipality of Reykjanesbær whose population as of 2016 is 15,129.

europe/kemi.description: Kemi is a town and municipality of Finland. It is located approximately 30 kilometres (19 mi) from the city of Tornio and the Swedish border.

europe/kilkenny.description: Kilkenny is a city in County Kilkenny, Ireland. It is located in the South-East Region and in the province of Leinster. It is built on both banks of the River Nore.

europe/killarney.description: Killarney is a town in County Kerry, Ireland.

europe/kiruna.description: Kiruna is the northernmost city in Sweden, situated in the province of Lapland. It had 17,002 inhabitants in 2016 and is the seat of Kiruna Municipality in Norrbotten County.

europe/kitzbuhel.description: Kitzbühel is a medieval town situated in the Kitzbühel Alps along the river Kitzbüheler Ache in Tyrol, Austria, about 100 km (62 mi) east of the state capital Innsbruck, and is the administrative centre of the Kitzbühel

europe/krakow.description: Kraków, officially the Royal Capital City of Kraków, is the second-largest and one of the oldest cities in Poland.

europe/kutna-hora.description: Kutná Hora is a town in the Central Bohemian Region of the Czech Republic. It has about 22,000 inhabitants. The history of Kutná Hora is linked to silver mining, which made it a rich and rapidly developing town.

europe/lagos.description: Lagos is a city and municipality in the Barlavento region of the Algarve, southern Portugal, situated at the mouth of the Bensafrim River along the Atlantic Ocean.

europe/lake-balaton.description: Lake Balaton is a freshwater rift lake in the Transdanubian region of Hungary. It is the largest lake in Central Europe, and one of the region's foremost tourist destinations.

europe/lake-como.description: Lake Como, also known as Lario, is a lake of glacial origin in Lombardy, Italy. It has an area of 146 km2 (56 sq mi), making it the third-largest lake in Italy, after Lake Garda and Lake Maggiore.

europe/lauterbrunnen.description: Lauterbrunnen is a village and municipality in the Interlaken-Oberhasli administrative district in the canton of Bern in Switzerland.

europe/leipzig.description: Leipzig is the most populous city in the German state of Saxony. The city has a population of 633,592 residents as of 31 December 2025.

europe/leuven.description: Leuven, also called Louvain, is the capital and largest city of the province of Flemish Brabant in the Flemish Region of Belgium. A Dutch-speaking municipality, it is located about 25 kilometres east of Brussels.

europe/levi.description: Levi is a fell located in Finnish Lapland, and the largest ski resort in Finland. The resort is located in the village of Sirkka, Kittilä municipality and is served by Kittilä Airport and Kolari railway station.

europe/liege.description: Liège is a city and municipality in the Belgian region of Wallonia, and the capital of the eponymous province.

europe/limerick.description: Limerick is a city in western Ireland, in County Limerick. It is in the province of Munster and is in the Mid-West which comprises part of the Southern Region.

europe/linz.description: Linz is the capital of Upper Austria and third-largest city in Austria. Located on the river Danube, the city is in the far north of Austria, 30 km (19 mi) south of the border with Czechia.

europe/lisbon.description: Lisbon is the capital and most populous city of Portugal, with an estimated population of 658,236 as of 2025, within its administrative limits and 3,353,000 within the metropolis, as of 2025.
europe/lisbon.credit: Vitor Oliveira from Torres Vedras, PORTUGAL

europe/liverpool.description: Liverpool is a port city and metropolitan borough in Merseyside, England. It is situated on the eastern side of the Mersey Estuary, near the Irish Sea, 178 miles (286 km) north-west of London.

europe/lofoten.description: Lofoten is an archipelago and a traditional district in the county of Nordland, Norway. Lofoten has distinctive scenery with dramatic mountains and peaks, open sea and sheltered bays, beaches, and untouched lands.

europe/loire-valley.description: The Loire Valley, spanning 280 kilometres (170 mi), is a valley located in the middle stretch of the Loire river in central France, in both the administrative regions Pays de la Loire and Centre-Val de Loire.

europe/london.description: London is the capital and largest city of England and the United Kingdom, with a population of 9.14 million people in 2025. Its wider metropolitan area is the largest in Western Europe, with a population of 15.4 million.

europe/lublin.description: Lublin is the eighth-largest city in Poland and the second-largest city of historical Lesser Poland. It is the capital and the centre of Lublin Voivodeship with a population of 336,339.

europe/lucerne.description: Lucerne or Luzern is a city and a municipality in central Switzerland, in the German-speaking portion of the country. Lucerne is the capital of the canton of Lucerne and part of the district of the same name.

europe/luxembourg-city.description: Luxembourg, also known as Luxembourg City, is the capital city of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg and the country's most populous commune.

europe/lyon.description: Lyon is a city in France.

europe/maastricht.description: Maastricht is a city and a municipality in the southeastern Netherlands. It is the capital and largest city of the province of Limburg.

europe/madrid.description: Madrid is the capital and largest city of Spain. It had a population of over 3.4 million in the city proper in 2025, and a metropolitan area population of approximately 6.8 million.

europe/malaga.description: Málaga is a municipality of Spain and the capital of the province of Málaga, in the autonomous community of Andalusia.

europe/malmo.description: Malmö is the third-largest city in Sweden, after Stockholm and Gothenburg, and the seventh-largest city in the Nordic region.

europe/manchester.description: Manchester is a city and metropolitan borough in North West England, at the centre of the eponymous county of Greater Manchester. It had a population of over 589,000 in 2024.

europe/marbella.description: Marbella is a city and municipality in southern Spain, belonging to the province of Málaga in the autonomous community of Andalusia.

europe/marseille.description: Marseille is a city in southern France, the prefecture of the Bouches-du-Rhône department and of the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region.

europe/matera.description: Matera is a city and the capital of the Province of Matera in the region of Basilicata, in Southern Italy.

europe/mechelen.description: Mechelen is a city and municipality in the province of Antwerp in the Flemish Region of Belgium.

europe/milan.description: Milan is the capital and largest city of the region of Lombardy, in northern Italy, and the seat of the Metropolitan City of Milan.

europe/mont-saint-michel.description: Mont-Saint-Michel is a tidal island and mainland commune in Normandy, France.

europe/montreux.description: Montreux is a Swiss municipality and town on the shoreline of Lake Geneva at the foot of the Alps.

europe/mount-titlis.description: Titlis is a mountain of the Uri Alps, located on the border between the cantons of Obwalden and Bern.

europe/munich.description: Munich is the capital and most populous city of the German state of Bavaria. As of 30 November 2024, its population was 1,604,384, making it the third most-populous city in Germany after Berlin and Hamburg.

europe/mykonos.description: Mykonos is a Greek island, part of the Cyclades, lying between Tinos, Syros, Paros and Naxos. The island has an area of 85.5 square kilometres (33.0 sq mi) and rises to an elevation of 341 metres at its highest point.

europe/naples.description: Naples is the regional capital of Campania, southern Italy.

europe/nice.description: Nice is a city and commune, and the prefecture of the department of Alpes-Maritimes, and the administrative region of Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, France.

europe/nuremberg.description: Nuremberg is the second-largest city in the German state of Bavaria and the largest city in the cultural region of Franconia. Its 546,397 (2024) inhabitants make it the 13th-largest city in Germany.

europe/odense.description: Odense is the third largest city in Denmark and the largest city on the island of Funen.

europe/olomouc.description: Olomouc is a city in the Czech Republic. It has about 105,000 inhabitants, making it the sixth largest city in the country. It is the administrative centre of the Olomouc Region.

europe/oslo.description: Oslo is the capital and largest city of Norway. It constitutes both a county and a municipality.

europe/oxford.description: Oxford is a cathedral city and non-metropolitan district in Oxfordshire, England, of which it is the county town.

europe/palermo.description: Palermo is the capital and largest city of the autonomous island region of Sicily in southern Italy, located on the eponymous gulf facing the Tyrrhenian Sea.

europe/paris.description: Paris is the capital and largest city of France, with an estimated city population of 2.04 million in an area of 105.4 km2 (40.7 sq mi), as of January 2026, and a metropolitan population of 13.3 million (2023).

europe/pecs.description: Pécs is the fifth largest city in Hungary, on the slopes of the Mecsek mountains in the country's southwest, close to the border with Croatia.

europe/pilsen.description: Plzeň, also known in English and German as Pilsen, is a city in the Czech Republic. It is the fourth most populous city in the Czech Republic with about 188,000 inhabitants.

europe/pisa.description: Pisa is a city and comune (municipality) in Tuscany, Central Italy, straddling the Arno just before it empties into the Ligurian Sea. It is the capital city of the Province of Pisa.

europe/poland.description: Poland, officially the Republic of Poland, is a country in Central Europe.

europe/ponta-delgada.description: Ponta Delgada is the largest municipality (concelho) and executive capital of the Autonomous Region of the Azores in Portugal. It is located on São Miguel Island, the largest and most populous in the archipelago.

europe/porto.description: Porto, also known in English as Oporto, is the second largest city in Portugal, after Lisbon. It is the capital of the Porto District and one of the Iberian Peninsula's major urban areas.

europe/portugal.description: Portugal, officially the Portuguese Republic, is a country in Southwestern Europe. Mainland Portugal is located on the southwestern portion of the Iberian Peninsula, and bordered by Spain to the north and east.

europe/porvoo.description: Porvoo is a city in Finland. It is located on the south coast of the country, on the Gulf of Finland. Porvoo lies in the eastern part of the Uusimaa region.

europe/positano.description: Positano is a town and comune (municipality) on the Amalfi Coast in the Province of Salerno in the region of Campania in southern Italy, mainly in an enclave in the hills leading down to the coast.

europe/poznan.description: Poznań is a city on the River Warta in west Poland, within the Greater Poland region.

europe/prague.description: Prague is the capital and largest city of the Czech Republic and the historical capital of Bohemia.

europe/remich.description: Remich is a commune with city status in south-eastern Luxembourg with a population of 4,101 inhabitants as of 2024. It is situated in the canton of the same name.

europe/reykjavik.description: Reykjavík is the capital and largest city of Iceland.

europe/ring-of-kerry.description: The Ring of Kerry is a 179-kilometre-long (111-mile) circular tourist route in County Kerry, south-western Ireland.
europe/ring-of-kerry.credit: Robert Linsdell from St. Andrews, Canada

europe/rome.description: Rome is the capital and largest city of Italy. It is also the administrative centre of the Lazio region and of the Metropolitan City of Rome.

europe/ronda.description: Ronda is a municipality of Spain belonging to the province of Málaga, within the autonomous community of Andalusia.

europe/roskilde.description: Roskilde is a city 30 km (19 mi) west of Copenhagen on the Danish island of Zealand. With a population of 53,897, the city is a business and educational centre for the region and the 10th largest city in Denmark.

europe/rothenburg-ob-der-tauber.description: Rothenburg ob der Tauber is a town in the district of Ansbach of Mittelfranken, in the Franconia region of Bavaria, Germany.

europe/rotterdam.description: Rotterdam is the second-largest city in the Netherlands by population and the largest by area (319.4 km2).

europe/rovaniemi.description: Rovaniemi is a city in Finland and the regional capital of Lapland. It is located near the Arctic Circle in the northern interior of the country.

europe/saariselka.description: Saariselkä is a fell area in Lapland, northern Finland. It is located in the Inari, Savukoski and Sodankylä municipalities. The highest point is 718 meters (2,356 ft) high Mt Sokosti.

europe/salzburg.description: Salzburg is the fourth-largest city in Austria. In 2026 its population was 157,994. The city lies on the Salzach River, near the border with Germany and at the foot of the Alps mountains.

europe/san-sebastian.description: San Sebastián or Donostia, officially known by the bilingual name Donostia / San Sebastián, is a city and municipality located in the Basque Autonomous Community in Spain.

europe/schaan.description: Schaan is the largest municipality of Liechtenstein by population. It is located to the north of Vaduz, the capital, in the central part of the country.

europe/selfoss.description: Selfoss is the main town and seat of Árborg in southern Iceland. It is on the banks of the Ölfusá river, 50 kilometres (31 mi) southeast of Reykjavík.

europe/seville.description: Seville is the capital and largest city of the autonomous community of Andalusia and the province of Seville in Spain.

europe/sicily.description: Sicily, officially the Sicilian Region, is an island in the central Mediterranean Sea and one of the twenty regions of Italy, situated south of the Italian Peninsula in continental Europe.

europe/siena.description: Siena is a city in the region of Tuscany in central Italy, and the capital of the province of Siena. With a population of 53,180, it is the 12th-largest city in the region.

europe/sintra.description: Sintra, officially the Town of Sintra, is a town and municipality in the Greater Lisbon region of Portugal, located on the Portuguese Riviera.

europe/sn-fellsnes-peninsula.description: The Snæfellsnes is a peninsula situated to the west of Borgarfjörður, in western Iceland.

europe/sorrento.description: Sorrento, officially Comune di Sorrento is a city and comune overlooking the Bay of Naples in Southern Italy.

europe/st-moritz.description: St. Moritz is a municipality and a high Alpine resort town in the Engadine in Switzerland, at an elevation of about 1,800 metres (5,910 ft) above sea level.

europe/stavanger.description: Stavanger, officially the Stavanger Municipality, is a city and municipality in Norway. It is the third largest city and third largest metropolitan area in Norway and the administrative center of Rogaland county.

europe/stirling.description: Stirling is a city in central Scotland, 26 miles (42 km) north-east of Glasgow and 37 miles (60 km) north-west of Edinburgh.

europe/stockholm.description: Stockholm is the capital and most populous city of Sweden, as well as the largest urban area in the Nordic countries.

europe/strasbourg.description: Strasbourg is a prefecture and commune, and the largest city of the Grand Est region of northeastern France, in the historic region of Alsace.

europe/stuttgart.description: Stuttgart is the capital and largest city of the German state of Baden-Württemberg.

europe/switzerland.description: Switzerland, officially the Swiss Confederation, is a landlocked country located at the intersection of Central, Western, and Southern Europe.

europe/szentendre.description: Szentendre, also known as Saint Andrew, is a riverside town in Pest County, Hungary, between the capital city Budapest and Pilis-Visegrád Mountains. The town is known for its museums, galleries, and artists.
europe/szentendre.credit: The original uploader was Mkesmarki at Hungarian Wikipedia.

europe/tampere.description: Tampere is a city in Finland and the regional capital of Pirkanmaa. It is in the Finnish Lakeland. Tampere's population is about 263,000, while the metropolitan area has a population of about 428,000.

europe/taormina.description: Taormina is a comune (municipality) in the Metropolitan City of Messina, on the east coast of the island of Sicily, Italy. Taormina has been a tourist destination since the 19th century.

europe/the-hague.description: The Hague is the capital city of the South Holland province of the Netherlands. With a population of over half a million, it is the third-largest city in the Netherlands.

europe/thessaloniki.description: Thessaloniki is the capital and largest city of the administrative region of Central Macedonia, and the second-largest city in Greece.

europe/toledo.description: Toledo is a city and municipality in Spain. It is the capital of the province of Toledo and the de jure seat of the government and parliament of the autonomous community of Castilla–La Mancha.

europe/torun.description: Toruń is a city on the Vistula River in north-central Poland and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its population was 196,935 as of December 2021.

europe/toulouse.description: Toulouse is a city in Southern France, the prefecture of the Haute-Garonne department and of the Occitania region.

europe/triesenberg.description: Triesenberg is a municipality in Liechtenstein with a population of 2,636. Its area of 29.69 square kilometres (11.46 sq mi) makes it the largest municipality in Liechtenstein.

europe/troms.description: Tromsø is a city in Tromsø Municipality in Troms county, Norway. The city is the administrative centre of the municipality and the county.
europe/troms.credit: The Municipality of Tromsø from Tromsø, Norway

europe/trondheim.description: Trondheim, historically Kaupangen, Nidaros, and Trondhjem, is a city and municipality in Trøndelag county, Norway. As of 1 January 2026, it had a population of 218,460.

europe/turku.description: Turku is a city in Finland and the regional capital of Southwest Finland. It is located on the southwestern coast of the country at the mouth of the River Aura.
europe/turku.credit: Markus Koljonen (Dilaudid) with thanks to Jontts and Turku Cathedral

europe/utrecht.description: Utrecht is the fourth-largest city of the Netherlands, as well as the capital and the most populous city of the province of Utrecht.
europe/utrecht.credit: Sebastiaan ter Burg from Utrecht, The Netherlands

europe/vaduz.description: Vaduz is the capital of Liechtenstein and also the seat of the national parliament. The town, which is located along the Rhine, has 5,696 residents.

europe/valencia.description: Valencia, known officially in Valencian as València, is the capital and largest city of the Valencian Community and the province of the same name in Spain.

europe/vatican-city.description: Vatican City, officially the Vatican City State, is a landlocked sovereign city-state in Southern Europe.

europe/venice.description: Venice is a coastal city in northeastern Italy and the capital of the region of Veneto, as well as the Metropolitan City of Venice.

europe/verona.description: Verona is the largest city in the region of Veneto in Italy, with a population of 255,139 as of 2026. It is one of the seven provincial capitals of the region, and is also the 2nd-largest city in northeast Italy.

europe/versailles.description: The Palace of Versailles is a château and historic monument in Versailles in the Yvelines department of France, southwest of Paris.

europe/vianden.description: Vianden is a commune with city status in north-eastern Luxembourg, with a population of 2,221 as of 2025. It is part of the canton of the same name.

europe/vienna.description: Vienna is the capital, most populous city, and one of the nine states of Austria. It is Austria's primate city, with just over two million inhabitants.

europe/vik.description: Vík í Mýrdal, also known as Vík in short, is the southernmost village in Iceland. It is located on the main ring road around the island, and is around 180 km (110 mi) southeast of Reykjavík by road.

europe/visby.description: Visby is an urban area in Sweden and the seat of Gotland Municipality in Gotland County on the island of Gotland with 24,330 inhabitants as of 2017. Visby is also the episcopal see for the Diocese of Visby.

europe/wachau-valley.description: The Wachau is an Austrian valley formed by the Danube River.

europe/warsaw.description: Warsaw, officially the Capital City of Warsaw, is the capital and most populous city of Poland. The metropolis stands on the river Vistula in east-central Poland.

europe/wroc-aw.description: Wrocław is a city in southwestern Poland, and the capital of the Lower Silesian Voivodeship. It is the largest city and historical capital of the regions of Silesia and Lower Silesia.

europe/york.description: York is a cathedral city in North Yorkshire, England, with Roman origins, sited at the confluence of the rivers Ouse and Foss.

europe/zaanse-schans.description: Zaanse Schans is a neighbourhood of Zaandam, near Zaandijk, Netherlands.

europe/zakopane.description: Zakopane is a town in the south of Poland, in the southern part of the Podhale region at the foot of the Tatra Mountains.

europe/zakynthos.description: Zakynthos, also known as Zante, is a Greek island in the Ionian Sea. It is the third largest of the Ionian Islands, with an area of 405.55 km2 (156.6 sq mi), and a coastline 123 km (76 mi) in length.

europe/zaragoza.description: Zaragoza, traditionally known in English as Saragossa, is the capital city of the autonomous community of Aragon and the province of Zaragoza in Spain.
europe/zaragoza.credit: Turol Jones, un artista de cojones from Villanueva del Cascajal, República Indep

europe/zell-am-see.description: Zell am See  is the administrative capital of the Zell am See District in the Austrian state of Salzburg.

europe/zermatt.description: Zermatt is a municipality in the district of Visp in the German-speaking section of the canton of Valais in Switzerland.

europe/zurich.description: Zurich is the largest city in Switzerland and the capital of the canton of Zurich. It is in north-central Switzerland, at the northwestern tip of Lake Zurich.

india/adi-kailash.description: Adi Kailash, also known as Shiva Kailash, Chota Kailash, Baba Kailash or Jonglingkong Peak, is a mountain located in the Himalayan mountain range in the Pithoragarh district of Uttarakhand, India.

india/agatti.description: Agatti Island is a 7.6 km long island, situated on a coral atoll called Agatti atoll in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep, India. It is 459 km (285 mi) west of the city of Kochi.

india/agra.description: Agra is a city on the banks of the Yamuna river in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh.

india/aharbal.description: Aharbal is a hill station in the south-western part of Kashmir Valley in the Indian union territory of Jammu and Kashmir, south of the summer capital of Srinagar.

india/ahmedabad.description: Ahmedabad, also spelt Amdavad and historically known as Karnavati, is the most populous city in the Indian state of Gujarat.

india/akola.description: Akola is a major city in the Vidarbha region of the Indian state of Maharashtra.

india/alleppey.description: Alappuzha or Alleppey is a city and municipality on the Laccadive Sea in the southern Indian state of Kerala.

india/almora.description: Almora is a municipal corporation and a cantonment town in the state of Uttarakhand, India. It is the administrative headquarters of Almora district.

india/ambikapur.description: Ambikapur is a city and headquarters of Surguja district in the Indian state of Chhattisgarh. It is one of the oldest cities in the state, in east-central India.

india/amravati.description: Amravati is a city in Maharashtra located in the Vidarbha region. It is the ninth largest city in Maharashtra, India & second largest city in the Vidarbha region in terms of population.

india/amritsar.description: Amritsar, also known as Ambarsar, is the second-largest city in the Indian state of Punjab, after Ludhiana. Located in the Majha region, it is a major cultural, transportation and economic centre.

india/anandpur-sahib.description: Sri Anandpur Sahib, also referred simply as Anandpur, is a city in Rupnagar district (Ropar), on the edge of Shivalik Hills, in the Indian state of Punjab.

india/balasore.description: Balasore, officially known as Baleshwar, is a city in the state of Odisha, about 215 km (134 mi) from the state capital Bhubaneswar and 240 km (149 mi) from Kolkata, in eastern India.

india/bangaon.description: Bangaon is a city and a municipality of North 24 Parganas district in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is the headquarters of the Bangaon subdivision.

india/baratang-island.description: Baratang Island is an island of the Andaman Islands. It belongs to the North and Middle Andaman administrative district, part of the Indian union territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

india/bardhaman.description: Bardhaman, officially Bardhaman Sadar, is a city and municipality located on the northern bank of the Damodar river in the state of West Bengal, India.

india/bengaluru.description: Bengaluru, also known as Bangalore, is the capital and largest city of the southern Indian state of Karnataka.

india/bhalukpong.description: Bhalukpung is a small town located along the southern reaches of the Himalayas in West Kameng district of Arunachal Pradesh in India.

india/bharatpur.description: Bharatpur is a city in the Indian state of Rajasthan, 189 km (117 mi) south of India's capital, New Delhi, 184 km (114 mi) from Rajasthan's capital Jaipur, 56 km (35 mi) west of Agra of Uttar Pradesh and 36 km (22 mi) fr

india/bhilai.description: Bhilai is a city in Durg district of the Indian state of Chhattisgarh, in east-central India.

india/bhitarkanika.description: Bhitarkanika Mangroves  is a mangrove wetland in Odisha, India, covering an area of 650 km2 (250 sq mi) in the Brahmani River and Baitarani River deltas.

india/bhopal.description: Bhopal is the capital city of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh and the administrative headquarters of both Bhopal district and Bhopal division.

india/bhubaneswar.description: Bhubaneswar, also known as Bhubaneshwar, is the capital and the largest city of the Indian state of Odisha. It is located in the Khordha district.

india/bhuj.description: Bhuj is a city and the headquarters of Kutch district in the Indian state of Gujarat. It was the capital of Kutch State, which was a princely state before it was merged into the Indian Union in 1947.

india/bikaner.description: Bikaner is a city in the Indian state of Rajasthan. It is situated approximately 330 kilometres (205 mi) northwest of the state capital, Jaipur, in the Thar Desert region of western Rajasthan.

india/bilaspur.description: Bilaspur is a city located in Bilaspur District in the Indian state of Chhattisgarh. Bilaspur is the administrative headquarters of the Bilaspur District and Bilaspur Division.

india/binsar.description: Binsar Wildlife Sanctuary is an Indian wildlife sanctuary.

india/bolpur.description: Bolpur is a city and a municipality in Birbhum district in the state of West Bengal, India. It is the headquarters of the Bolpur subdivision. Bolpur municipal area includes Santiniketan.

india/bomdila.description: Bomdila is the headquarters of West Kameng district in the state of Arunachal Pradesh in India. Bomdila is one of the 60 constituencies of the state of Arunachal Pradesh.

india/chandigarh.description: Chandigarh is a city and union territory in northwestern India, serving as a shared capital for the states of Punjab and Haryana.

india/chandratal.description: Chandra Taal is a lake in the upper Chandra valley of the Lahul and Spiti district of Himachal Pradesh, India. Chandra Taal is near the source of the Chandra River.

india/chhatrapati-sambhajinagar.description: Aurangabad, officially renamed as Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in 2023, is a city in the Indian state of Maharashtra.

india/chittorgarh.description: Chittorgarh is a major city in the state of Rajasthan in western India. It lies on the Berach River, a tributary of the Banas, and is the administrative headquarters of Chittorgarh District.

india/cochin.description: Kochi, formerly known as Cochin, is a major port city along the Malabar Coast of India bordering the Laccadive Sea.

india/cooch-behar.description: Cooch Behar, also known as Koch Bihar, is a city in the Indian state of West Bengal and it stands on bank of the Torsa river. The city is the headquarters of the Cooch Behar district.

india/coorg.description: Kodagu district is an administrative district in the Karnataka state of India. Before 1956, it was an administratively separate Coorg State at which point it was merged into an enlarged Mysore State.

india/cuttack.description: Cuttack, is the second largest city and the former capital of the Indian state of Odisha. It is also the headquarters of the Cuttack district.

india/daringbadi.description: Daringbadi is a hill station in Kandhmal district of Odisha state in eastern India. It is situated at an elevation of 915 metres and is a popular tourist destination.
india/daringbadi.credit: The original uploader was সন্দীপ সরকার at Bangla Wikipedia.

india/darjeeling.description: Darjeeling is a city in the northernmost region of the Indian state of West Bengal. Located in the Eastern Himalayas, it has an average elevation of 2,045 metres (6,709 ft).

india/dawki.description: Dawki or Dauki is a town in West Jaintia Hills district, Meghalaya, India.

india/dharamshala.description: Dharamshala is a town in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. It serves as the winter capital of the state and the administrative headquarters of the Kangra district since 1855.

india/dharchula.description: Dharchula, is a town in the Pithoragarh district of Uttarakhand, India. It is located at an elevation of about 940 metres above sea level and is surrounded by high Himalayan peaks.

india/dhordo.description: Dhordo is a small village located in Kutch district, Gujarat, India. This village is situated within Bhuj taluk on the edge of the India-Pakistan border and is around 86 km from Bhuj.

india/dirang.description: Dirang or simply Dirang H.Q. is a town on NH-13 in the district of West Kameng in the Indian state of Arunachal Pradesh. The National Institute of Mountaineering and Adventure Sports (NIMAS) is located here.

india/dudhsagar-falls.description: Dudhsagar Falls is a four-tiered waterfall on the Mahadayi River in the Indian state of Goa.

india/durgapur.description: Durgapur, is a major industrial hub and a planned urban agglomeration in the Indian state of West Bengal. It stands on the northern bank of the Damodar river and is located in Paschim Bardhaman district.

india/gandhinagar.description: Gandhinagar in India is the capital of the state of Gujarat and of Gandhinagar district.

india/gangtok.description: Gangtok is the capital and the most populous city of the Indian state of Sikkim. The seat of eponymous district, Gangtok is in the eastern Himalayan range, at an elevation of 1,650 m (5,410 ft).

india/gulmarg.description: Gulmarg is a hill station and a notified area committee in Baramulla district of the Indian union territory of Jammu and Kashmir.

india/guntur.description: Guntur, natively spelt as Gunturu, is a city in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh and the administrative headquarters of Guntur district.

india/gurez-valley.description: Gurez, or Gurais, is a tehsil in Bandipore District in Jammu and Kashmir in India.

india/guwahati.description: Guwahati, formerly known as Gauhati, is the largest city of the Indian state of Assam, and also the largest metropolis in northeastern India.

india/gwalior.description: Gwalior is the fourth largest city of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh where it serves as the capital and the administrative headquarters of the eponymous district and division.

india/haldia.description: Haldia is an industrial port city in Purba Medinipur district in the Indian state of West Bengal.

india/hanle.description: Hanle is a town and tehsil in the Changthang district of the Indian union territory of Ladakh. It is located in the Hanle River valley on an old branch of the ancient Ladakh–Tibet trade route.

india/haridwar.description: Haridwar is a city and municipal corporation in the Haridwar district of Uttarakhand, India.

india/havelock-island.description: Havelock Island, officially known as Swaraj Dweep, is one of the largest islands in Ritchie's Archipelago, to the east of Great Andaman within the Andaman Islands of India.

india/howrah.description: Howrah is a city in the Indian state of West Bengal. Howrah is located on the western bank of the Hooghly River, opposite to its twin city of Kolkata.

india/hunder.description: Hundar is a village in the Nubra district of Ladakh, India, famous for sand dunes and Bactrian camels. It is located in the Diskit tehsil, on the banks of the Shyok River. The Hunder Monastery is located here.

india/hyderabad.description: Hyderabad is the capital and largest city of the Indian state of Telangana. It occupies 650 km2 (250 sq mi) on the Deccan Plateau along the banks of the Musi River, in the northern part of Southern India.

india/indore.description: Indore is the largest city of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh where it serves as the capital and the administrative headquarters of the eponymous district and division.

india/jabalpur.description: Jabalpur, formerly anglicised as Jubbulpore, is the fourth largest city by area of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh. It is situated on the banks of the Narmada River in the state of Madhya Pradesh, India.

india/jagdalpur.description: Jagdalpur is a city located in the southern part of Chhattisgarh state in India. It is the administrative headquarters of the Bastar district and Bastar division.

india/jaipur.description: Jaipur is the capital and largest city of the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan. As of 2011, the city had a population of 3.1 million, making it the tenth-most populous city in the country.

india/jaisalmer.description: Jaisalmer, nicknamed The Golden City, is a city in the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan, located 575 kilometres (357 mi) west of the state capital Jaipur, in the heart of the Thar Desert.

india/jispa.description: Jispa is a village in Lahaul, in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. It's located along the Manali–Leh Highway (NH‑3) on the banks of the Bhaga River, approximately 20 km north of Keylong and 7 km south of Darcha.
