india/jodhpur.description: Jodhpur is the second-largest city of the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan, after its capital, Jaipur. As of 2025, the city has a population of 1.6 million.

india/jowai.description: Jowai is the headquarters of the West Jaintia Hills district of the state of Meghalaya, India, and is home to the Pnar, a sub-tribe of the Khasi people.

india/kadmat.description: Kadmat Island, also known as Cardamom Island, is a coral island belonging to the Amindivi subgroup of islands of the Lakshadweep archipelago in India.

india/kanpur.description: Kanpur, formerly anglicized as Cawnpore, is a large city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh.

india/kanyakumari.description: Kanyakumari is a town and municipality in Kanyakumari district in the state of Tamil Nadu, India.

india/kargil.description: Kargil or Kargyil is a city and headquarter of the eponymous district, tehsil, and community development block of Indian-administered Ladakh in the disputed Kashmir region.

india/karimnagar.description: Karimnagar, formerly known as Elagandula, is a city and District Headquarters in the Indian state of Telangana. Karimnagar is a major urban agglomeration in the state.

india/kasol.description: Kasol is a hamlet in the Kullu district of the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. It is situated in Parvati Valley, on the banks of the Parvati River between Bhuntar and Manikaran.

india/kausani.description: Kausani is a hill station and Village situated in Bageshwar district in the state of Uttarakhand, India.
india/kausani.credit: Abhijit Kar Gupta from Kolkata, India

india/kavaratti.description: Kavaratti is an atoll in the Indian Union Territory of Lakshadweep. The census town of Kavaratti, which is the major settlement in the atoll, serves as the capital of Lakshadweep.

india/kaza.description: Kaza, also spelled Kaze, Karze, Karzey, is a town and the subdivisional headquarters of the remote Spiti Valley in the western Himalayas in the Lahaul and Spiti district of the northern Indian state of Himachal Pradesh.

india/kaziranga.description: Kaziranga National Park is a national park and World Heritage Site in the Golaghat, Sonitpur, Biswanath and Nagaon districts of the Indian state of Assam.

india/khajuraho.description: Khajuraho is a city, near Chhatarpur in Chhatarpur district of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh.

india/kharagpur.description: Kharagpur is a semi-planned urban agglomeration and a major industrial city in the Paschim Medinipur district of West Bengal, India.

india/kodaikanal.description: Kodaikanal is a town and hill station in Dindigul district in the state of Tamil Nadu, India. It is situated at an altitude of 2,225 m (7,300 ft) in the Palani Hills of the Western Ghats.

india/kolhapur.description: Kolhapur is a city on the banks of the Panchganga River in the southern part of the Indian state of Maharashtra.

india/kolkata.description: Kolkata, also known as Calcutta, is the capital and largest city of the Indian state of West Bengal. It lies on the eastern bank of the Hooghly River, 80 km (50 mi) west of the border with Bangladesh.

india/kota.description: Kota, previously known as Kotah, is the third-largest city of the Indian state of Rajasthan. It is located about 230 km south of the state capital, Jaipur, on the banks of the Chambal River.

india/kullu.description: Kullu is a municipal council town that serves as the administrative headquarters of the Kullu district of the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh.

india/kurnool.description: Kurnool is a city in the state of Andhra Pradesh, India. It formerly served as the capital of Andhra State (1953–1956). The city is often referred to as "The Gateway of Rayalaseema".

india/leh.description: Leh is a city in Indian-administered Ladakh in the disputed Kashmir region. It is the largest city and the joint capital of Ladakh.

india/lolab-valley.description: The Lolab Valley, earlier known as Lolo, is a Himalayan sub-valley of the larger Kashmir Valley located in the northern Kupwara district of the Indian union territory of Jammu and Kashmir in the disputed Kashmir region.

india/lucknow.description: Lucknow is a metropolis and the second largest city of the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh where it serves as the capital and the administrative headquarters of the eponymous district and division.

india/madurai.description: Madurai is a major city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.

india/majuli.description: Majuli is the largest river island in Assam, a state in Northeast India. It is bordered by the Brahmaputra River to the south and east, the Subansiri River to the west, and an anabranch of the Brahmaputra to the north.

india/manali.description: Manali is a resort town, near Kullu town in the Kullu district in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. It is situated at the northern end of the Kullu Valley, formed by the Beas River.

india/manas-national-park.description: Manas National Park is a national park, Project Tiger reserve, and an elephant reserve in Assam, India. Located in the Himalayan foothills, it borders the Royal Manas National Park in Bhutan.

india/mawlynnong.description: Mawlynnong is a village in the East Khasi Hills district of the Meghalaya state in North East India. It is notable for its cleanliness and also was chosen by Discover India magazine as Asia's cleanest village.

india/mcleod-ganj.description: McLeod Ganj or McLeodganj is a suburb of Dharamshala town, in the Kangra district, Himachal Pradesh, India.

india/midnapore.description: Midnapore, is a city known for its history in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is the headquarters of the Paschim Medinipur district. It is situated on the banks of the Kangsabati River.

india/minicoy.description: Minicoy, locally known as Maliku, is an island in Lakshadweep, India. Along with Viringili, it is on Maliku atoll, the southernmost atoll of Lakshadweep archipelago.

india/mount-abu.description: Abu Raj [formerly Mount Abu ] is a hill station in the Sirohi district of the state of Rajasthan in western India. Here, the mountain forms a rocky plateau 22 km (14 mi) long by 9 km (5.6 mi) wide.

india/mumbai.description: Mumbai, also known as Bombay, is the capital city of the Indian state of Maharashtra and the financial capital of India. Located on the Konkan coast along the west coast of India, it has a deep natural harbour.

india/munnar.description: Munnar is a town located in the Idukki district of the southwestern Indian state of Kerala. Munnar is situated at around 1,600 metres (5,200 ft) above mean sea level, in the Western Ghats mountain range.

india/munsiyari.description: Munsyari is the name of the sub-division headquarters, a municipal board, a conglomeration of revenue villages and it also refers to the entire region as Munsiyari Tehsil and Sub Division in the Pithoragarh District in t

india/murshidabad.description: Murshidabad is a town in the Indian state of West Bengal. This town is the headquarters of Lalbag subdivision of Murshidabad district. It is located on the eastern bank of the Bhagirathi River.

india/mysuru.description: Mysore, officially Mysuru, is a city in the southern Indian state of Karnataka. It is the administrative headquarters of Mysore district and Mysore division.

india/nagpur.description: Nagpur is the largest and most populous city in central India. It is the second capital and the third-largest city of the Indian state Maharashtra.

india/nainital.description: Nainital, formerly anglicized as Naini Tal, is a town and headquarters of Nainital district of Kumaon division, Uttarakhand, India.

india/namchi.description: Namchi is a town and the administrative headquarters of the South Sikkim district in the Indian state of Sikkim.

india/narkanda.description: Narkanda is a hill station town. It is a nagar panchayat in Kumarsain subdivision of Shimla district in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh.

india/nashik.description: Nashik, formerly Nasik, is a city in the northern region of the Indian state of Maharashtra situated on the banks of the river Godavari, about 165 km (103 mi) northeast of the state capital Mumbai.

india/neil-island.description: Neil Island, officially known as Shaheed Dweep, is an island of the Andaman Islands, located in Ritchie's Archipelago.

india/nellore.description: Nellore, also spelt as Nelluru, is a city located on the banks of Penna River, in Nellore district of Andhra Pradesh, India.

india/om-parvat.description: Om Parvat is a mountain located on the India–Nepal border between Darchula district, Sudurpashchim Province, Nepal, and the disputed Kalapani territory administered by India within the Pithoragarh district, Uttarakhand.

india/omkareshwar.description: Omkareshwar Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Shiva, located in Mandhata, nearby Khandwa city in Khandwa district of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh. It is one of the 12 revered Jyotirlinga shrines of Shiva.

india/ooty.description: Ooty is a town and seat of the Nilgiris district in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.

india/pachmarhi.description: Pachmarhi is a hill station in Madhya Pradesh state of central India. It has been the location of a cantonment since the British Raj.

india/pahalgam.description: Pahalgam or Pahalgom is a town in Anantnag district of the Indian union territory of Jammu and Kashmir. It is located on the banks of Lidder River at an altitude of 2,200 m (7,200 ft) in the Vale of Kashmir.

india/panaji.description: Panaji, also known as Panjim, is the capital of the Indian state of Goa and the headquarters of the North Goa district. It was previously the territorial capital of the former Portuguese India.

india/patiala.description: Patiala is a city in southeastern Punjab, northwestern India. It is the fourth largest city in the state and is the administrative capital of Patiala district.

india/pelling.description: Pelling  is a hill station in ( རྒྱལ་ཤིང་རྫོང་།) Gyalshing district of Sikkim, India. Pelling is nestled at an altitude of 2,150 m (7,050 ft).

india/pimpri-chinchwad.description: Pimpri-Chinchwad, also known as PCMC, is a city in the Indian state of Maharashtra. The city is about 15 km (9.3 mi) northwest of the historic city of Pune, at an altitude of 590 m (1,940 ft) above sea level.

india/pithoragarh.description: Pithoragarh is a Himalayan town and a municipal corporation in Pithoragarh district, Kumaon division, Uttarakhand state, northern India. It is the largest hill town in Uttarakhand.

india/port-blair.description: Port Blair, officially named Sri Vijaya Puram, is the capital city of the Indian union territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

india/pune.description: Pune, previously spelled in English as Poona, is a city in the state of Maharashtra in the Deccan Plateau in Western India. It is the administrative headquarters of the Pune district, and of Pune division.

india/puri.description: Puri, also known as Jagannath Puri, is a coastal city and a Municipal Corporation in the state of Odisha in eastern India.

india/purulia.description: Purulia, officially Purulia Sadar, is a city and a municipality in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is the headquarters of the Purulia district and is located on the north of the Kangsabati River.

india/raigarh.description: Raigarh is a city in northern Chhattisgarh known as the 'Cultural capital of Chhattisgarh'; Raigarh is famous for its dance form “SUWA” and classical music; Raigarh is also known as Sanskritidhani.

india/raipur.description: Raipur is the capital city of the Indian state of Chhattisgarh. Raipur is also the administrative headquarters of Raipur district and Raipur division, and the most populous city of the state.

india/rajkot.description: Rajkot is the fourth-largest city in the western Indian state of Gujarat, after Ahmedabad, Surat, and Vadodara. It is in the centre of the Saurashtra region of Gujarat.

india/rameswaram.description: Rameswaram is a town in the Ramanathapuram district of the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.

india/rangpo.description: Rangpo is a Municipal town in India shared by Pakyong district of the state Sikkim and Kalimpong district of the state West Bengal. The town is situated along the Teesta River and Rangpo River.

india/rourkela.description: Rourkela officially Raurkela is a planned city located in the northern district Sundargarh of Odisha, India. It is a Tier-2 city and the third-largest city in Odisha after Bhubaneswar and Cuttack.

india/sambalpur.description: Sambalpur, also known as Sambalpore, is the fifth-largest city in the Indian State of Odisha. It is located on the banks of river Mahanadi, with a population of 335,761. Prehistoric settlements have been recorded there.

india/sanchi.description: Sanchi Stupa is a Buddhist complex, famous for its Great Stupa, on a hilltop at Sanchi Town in Raisen District of the State of Madhya Pradesh, India.

india/sarahan.description: Sarahan is a small town in Himachal Pradesh, India.

india/shillong.description: Shillong, the capital of Meghalaya, India, is a hill station and the headquarters of the East Khasi Hills district. It is the 330th most populous city in India, with a population of 143,229 according to the 2011 census.

india/shimla.description: Shimla is the summer capital and largest city of northern Indian state Himachal Pradesh. It is the state's most developed city and its centre of commerce, culture and education.

india/siliguri.description: Siliguri, also known as Shiliguri, is a major tier-II city in West Bengal. It forms the Twin Cities with the neighbouring city of Jalpaiguri.

india/singtam.description: Singtam is a town which lies mostly in Gangtok District and partly in Pakyong District in the Indian state of Sikkim about 30 kilometres (19 mi) from the state capital Gangtok.

india/sinthan-top.description: Sinthan Top is a mountain pass, a popular tourist destination located in Kishtwar district and borders with South Kashmir's Breng Valley of Anantnag district in the Indian union territory of Jammu and Kashmir in the disp

india/sivasagar.description: Sivasagar is a city and headquarter of the Sivasagar district, Assam. It is known for its Ahom palaces and monuments. Sivasagar is an important centre for tea and oil industries today.

india/sonmarg.description: Sonamarg or Sonmarg, known as Sonamarag in Kashmiri, is a hill station located in the Ganderbal District of Jammu and Kashmir, India in the disputed Kashmir region.

india/srinagar.description: Srinagar is a city in Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir in the disputed Kashmir region. It is the largest city and summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir, which is an Indian-administered union territory.

india/sumur.description: Nubra, also called Dumra, is a historical region of Ladakh, India in the Nubra district. Its inhabited areas form a tri-armed valley cut by the Nubra and Shyok rivers. Its Tibetan name Dumra means "valley of flowers".

india/sundarbans.description: Sundarbans is a mangrove forest area in the Ganges Delta formed by the confluence of the Ganges, Brahmaputra and Meghna Rivers in the Bay of Bengal.

india/surat.description: Surat is a city in the western Indian state of Gujarat. The word Surat directly translates to countenance in Gujarati, Hindi and Urdu.

india/tabo.description: Tabo is a small town in the Lahaul and Spiti district on the banks of the Spiti River in Himachal Pradesh, India. The town lies on the road between Rekong Peo and Kaza, the sub-divisional headquarters of Spiti.

india/tawang.description: Tawang is a town and administrative headquarter of Tawang district in the Indian state of Arunachal Pradesh. It lies on NH-13 section of Trans-Arunachal Highway.

india/tezpur.description: Tezpur is a city in Sonitpur district, Assam state, India. Tezpur is located on the banks of the river Brahmaputra, 175 kilometres (109 mi) northeast of Guwahati, and is the largest of the north bank cities.

india/thekkady.description: Thekkady in Idukki district is a town near Periyar National Park, a tourist attraction in the Indian state of Kerala. The name Thekkady is derived from the word "thekku" which means teak and "adi" meaning bottom.

india/trivandrum.description: Thiruvananthapuram, also known as Trivandrum, is the capital city of the Indian state of Kerala.

india/tso-moriri.description: Tso Moriri or Lake Moriri, 4,522 m (14,836 ft), is a high-altitude lake and a Ramsar wetland site in the remote Changthang Plateau in the Changthang district of the union territory of Ladakh in India.

india/udaipur.description: Udaipur is a city in the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan, about 415 km (258 mi) south of the state capital Jaipur. It serves as the administrative headquarters of Udaipur district.

india/ujjain.description: Ujjain, also known as Ujjayini, is a city in Ujjain district of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh.

india/vadodara.description: Vadodara, also known as Baroda, is a city on the banks of the Vishwamitri River in the Indian state of Gujarat. It serves as the administrative headquarters of the Vadodara district.

india/valley-of-flowers.description: Valley of Flowers National Park is an Indian national park which was established in 1982.
india/valley-of-flowers.credit: Original: Rohit Sharma Derivative work: UnpetitproleX

india/vijayawada.description: Vijayawada, also called as Bezawada, is the second largest city and a major commercial hub in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.

india/visakhapatnam.description: Visakhapatnam is the largest and most populous city in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. It is between the Eastern Ghats and the coast of the Bay of Bengal.

india/warangal.description: Warangal, also known as Orugallu, is a city in the Indian state of Telangana and the district headquarters of Warangal district.

india/yusmarg.description: Yusmarg or Yousmarg is a hill station in the western part of the Budgam district of Jammu and Kashmir, India. It is situated 43 km from Budgam town and 53 km (33 mi) south of Srinagar, the summer capital of the state.

middle-east/abu-dhabi.description: Abu Dhabi is the capital city of the United Arab Emirates (UAE), and of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, the seat of the Abu Dhabi Central Capital District and the UAE's second-most populous city, after Dubai.

middle-east/ajloun.description: Ajloun, also spelled Ajlun, is the capital town of the Ajloun Governorate, a hilly town in the north of Jordan, located 76 kilometers north west of Amman.

middle-east/amman.description: Amman is the capital and the largest city of Jordan, and the country's economic, political, and cultural center.

middle-east/antalya.description: Antalya is one of the largest cities in Turkey and the capital of Antalya Province, the fifth-most populous province.

middle-east/cappadocia.description: Cappadocia is a historical region in Central Anatolia region, Turkey. It is largely in the provinces of Nevşehir, Kayseri, Aksaray, Kırşehir, Sivas and Niğde.

middle-east/istanbul.description: Istanbul is the largest city in Turkey, a megacity, constituting the country's economic, cultural, and historical center. With a population of over 15 million, it is home to 18% of the population of Turkey.

middle-east/jerash.description: Jerash or Jarash is a city in northern Jordan. The city is the administrative center of the Jerash Governorate, and has a population of 50,745 as of 2015. It is located 30.0 miles north of the capital city Amman.

middle-east/mt-nebo.description: Mount Nebo is an elevated ridge located in Jordan, approximately 700 metres (2,300 ft) above sea level.

middle-east/muscat.description: Muscat is the capital and most populous city of Oman. It is the seat of the Governorate of Muscat.

middle-east/pamukkale.description: Pamukkale, meaning "cotton castle" in Turkish, is a natural site in Denizli Province in southwestern Turkey. The area is famous for a carbonate mineral left by the flowing of thermal spring water.

middle-east/ras-al-khaimah.description: The Emirate of Ras Al Khaimah is the northernmost of the seven emirates that make up the United Arab Emirates.

middle-east/sharjah.description: Sharjah is a major port city and the third-most populous city in the United Arab Emirates, after Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

oceania/auckland.description: Auckland is a large metropolitan city in the North Island of New Zealand. It has an urban population of approximately 1,547,200.

oceania/brisbane.description: Brisbane is the capital and most populous city of the Australian state of Queensland and the third-most populous city in Australia, with a population of about 2.8 million.

oceania/cairns.description: Cairns is a city in the Cairns Region, Queensland, Australia, on the tropical northeast coast of Far North Queensland. In the 2021 census, Cairns had a population of 169,312.

oceania/christchurch.description: Christchurch, also known by its Māori name Ōtautahi, is the largest city in the South Island and the second-largest city by urban area population in New Zealand.
oceania/christchurch.credit: Bernard Spragg. NZ from Christchurch, New Zealand

oceania/lautoka.description: Lautoka is the second largest metropolitan area in Fiji. It is on the west coast of the island of Viti Levu, in the Ba Province of the Western Division.

oceania/melbourne.description: Melbourne is the capital and most populous city of the Australian state of Victoria and the second-most populous city in Australia.

oceania/nadi.description: Nadi is the third-largest city in Fiji, after Suva and Lautoka. It is located on the western side of the main island of Viti Levu, and had a population of 59,707 at the most recent census, in 2017.

oceania/nausori.description: Nausori is a town in Fiji. It had a population of 57,866 at the 2017 census. This makes it the fourth most populous municipality in the country.

oceania/philip-island.description: Phillip Island is an Australian island about 125 km (78 mi) south-southeast of Melbourne, Victoria.

oceania/rotorua.description: Rotorua is a city in the Bay of Plenty Region of New Zealand's North Island, situated on the southern shores of Lake Rotorua, from which it takes its name.

oceania/sigatoka.description: Sigatoka is a town in Fiji. It is on the island of Viti Levu at the mouth of the Sigatoka River, for which it is named, some 61 kilometres from Nadi. Its population at the 2017 census was 17,622.

oceania/suva.description: Suva is the capital and most populous settlement of Fiji. It is the centre of Fiji's largest metropolitan area and serves as its major port.

oceania/sydney.description: Sydney is the capital of the state of New South Wales and the largest city in Australia.

russia/irkutsk.description: Irkutsk is the largest city and administrative center of Irkutsk Oblast, Russia.

russia/kazan.description: Kazan is the capital and largest city of Tatarstan, Russia.

russia/khabarovsk.description: Khabarovsk is the administrative centre and largest city of Khabarovsk Krai, Russia, located 30 kilometers (19 mi) from the China–Russia border, at the confluence of the Amur and Ussuri Rivers, about 800 kilometers (500

russia/krasnoyarsk.description: Krasnoyarsk is the largest city and administrative centre of Krasnoyarsk Krai, Russia.

russia/moscow.description: Moscow is the capital and largest city of Russia, situated on the Moskva River in Central Russia.

russia/murmansk.description: Murmansk is the administrative center and largest city of Murmansk Oblast in the far northwest part of Russia. It is a major port city and is the world's most populous city north of the Arctic Circle.

russia/nizhny-novgorod.description: Nizhny Novgorod, colloquially shortened to Nizhny and from 1932 to 1990 known as Gorky, is the administrative centre and largest city of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, and the administrative centre of the Volga Federal District

russia/novosibirsk.description: Novosibirsk is the administrative centre and largest city of Novosibirsk Oblast and the Siberian Federal District in Russia.

russia/teriberka.description: Teriberka is a rural locality in Kolsky District of Murmansk Oblast, Russia, located on the Barents Sea coast, at the mouth of the river Teriberka.

russia/ulan-ude.description: Ulan-Ude is the capital city of Buryatia, Russia, located about 100 kilometers (62 mi) southeast of Lake Baikal on the Uda River at its confluence with the Selenga.

russia/vladivostok.description: Vladivostok is the largest city and the administrative center of Primorsky Krai and the capital of the Far Eastern Federal District of Russia.

south-asia/bentota.description: Bentota is a coastal town in Sri Lanka, located in the Galle District of the Southern Province. It is approximately 65 kilometres (40 mi) south of Colombo and 56 kilometres (35 mi) north of Galle.

south-asia/birgunj.description: Birgunj is a metropolitan city in Parsa District in Madhesh Province in southern Nepal. It lies 135 km (84 mi) south of the capital Kathmandu, attached in the north to Raxaul on the border of the Indian state of Bihar.

south-asia/chitwan.description: Chitwan District is one of seventy-seven districts of Nepal, and takes up the southwestern corner of Bagmati Province which covers 2,238.39 km2 (864.25 sq mi), and in 2011 had a population of 579,984 people.

south-asia/colombo.description: Colombo is Sri Lanka's executive and judicial capital, as well as the country's most populous city. It is also the financial centre of the island and a tourist destination.

south-asia/dambulla.description: Dambulla is a city situated in the north of Matale District, in Sri Lanka's Central Province. It is the second largest populated and urbanised centre after Matale in the Matale District.

south-asia/ghandruk.description: Ghandruk is a picturesque traditional village nestled in the Annapurna Rural Municipality, Kaski District of the Gandaki Province of Nepal.

south-asia/kathmandu.description: Kathmandu is the capital and largest city of Nepal, situated in the central part of the country within the Kathmandu Valley. The city is in Kathmandu District.

south-asia/male.description: Malé is the capital and most populous city of the Maldives.

south-asia/mirissa.description: Mirissa is a small town on the south coast of Sri Lanka, located in the Matara District of the Southern Province.

south-asia/naifaru.description: Naifaru is an island in the Maldives 144 km (89 mi) north of the capital, Malé. It is the capital and most populous island of Lhaviyani Atoll.

south-asia/paro.description: Paro is a town and seat of Paro District, in the Paro Valley of Bhutan. It is a historic town with many sacred sites and historical buildings scattered throughout the area.

south-asia/pokhara.description: Pokhara is a metropolitan city located in central Nepal, which serves as the capital of Gandaki Province.

south-asia/punakha.description: Punakha is the administrative centre of Punakha dzongkhag, one of the 20 districts of Bhutan. Punakha was the capital of Bhutan and the seat of government until 1955, when the capital was moved to Thimphu.
south-asia/punakha.credit: The original uploader was Technopilgrim at English Wikipedia.

south-asia/thimphu.description: Thimphu is the capital and largest city of Bhutan. It is situated in the western central part of Bhutan, and the surrounding valley is one of Bhutan's dzongkhags, the Thimphu District.

south-east-asia/bali.description: Bali is an Indonesian island and province and the westernmost of the Lesser Sunda Islands.

south-east-asia/bangkok.description: Bangkok, known in Thai as Krung Thep Maha Nakhon and colloquially as Krung Thep, is the capital and largest city of Thailand.

south-east-asia/batu-cave.description: Batu Caves are a series of limestone caves in Gombak, Selangor, Malaysia. It is located on a 325 m (1,066 ft)–tall mogote, about 13 km (8.1 mi) north of the Malaysian capital of Kuala Lumpur.

south-east-asia/bohol.description: Bohol, officially the Province of Bohol, is an island province of the Philippines located in the Central Visayas region, consisting of the island itself and 75 minor surrounding islands. It is home to Boholano people.

south-east-asia/boracay.description: Boracay is a resort island in the Western Visayas region of the Philippines, located 0.8 kilometers (0.50 mi) off the northwest coast of Panay Island.

south-east-asia/cameron-highlands.description: The Cameron Highlands is a district in Pahang, Malaysia, occupying an area of 712.18 square kilometres (274.97 sq mi).

south-east-asia/cebu.description: Cebu, officially the Province of Cebu, is a province of the Philippines located in the Central Visayas (Region VII) region. It consists of the main island and 167 surrounding islands and islets.

south-east-asia/danang.description: Da Nang, also written unspaced as Danang, is the fourth largest city in Vietnam by population and the second largest by geographical area and located in the South Central Coast and Central Highlands.

south-east-asia/ha-long-bay.description: Hạ Long Bay or Halong Bay is a bay located in Northeastern Vietnam, administered by the city of Quảng Ninh. The name Hạ Long means "descending dragon".

south-east-asia/ha-noi.description: Hanoi is the capital and second-most populous centrally-governed city of Vietnam. It covers an area of 3,358.6 km2 (1,296.8 mi2), and as of 2026 has a population of 8.7 million.

south-east-asia/krabi.description: Krabi is the capital of and main town in Krabi Province, on the west coast of southern Thailand, where the Krabi River flows into Phang Nga Bay.

south-east-asia/kuala-lumpur.description: Kuala Lumpur (KL), officially the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, is the capital city and a federal territory of Malaysia.

south-east-asia/langkawi.description: Langkawi, officially known as Langkawi, the Jewel of Kedah, is a duty-free island and an archipelago of 99 islands located some 30 kilometres (19 mi) off the coast of northwestern Malaysia and a few kilometres south of K

south-east-asia/luang-prabang.description: Luang Prabang, historically known as Xieng Thong, and alternatively spelled Luang Phabang or Louangphabang, is the capital of Luang Prabang Province in north-central Laos.

south-east-asia/manila.description: Manila, officially the City of Manila, is the capital and second-most populous city of the Philippines after Quezon City. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 1,902,590 people.

south-east-asia/marina-bay-sands.description: Marina Bay Sands is an integrated resort fronting Marina Bay in Singapore and a landmark of the city.

south-east-asia/mekong-delta.description: The Mekong Delta, also known as the South-western Region or the Western Region, is the region in southwestern Vietnam where the Mekong River approaches and empties into the sea through a network of distributaries.

south-east-asia/night-safari.description: Night Safari is the world's first nocturnal zoo, located in Mandai, Singapore.

south-east-asia/palawan.description: Palawan is an archipelagic province of the Philippines that is located in the region of Mimaropa. It is the largest province in the country in terms of total area, with 14,649.73 km2 (5,656.29 mi2).

south-east-asia/pattaya.description: Pattaya is a city in Eastern Thailand, the largest city in Chonburi province and the eighth-largest city in Thailand.

south-east-asia/phnom-penh.description: Phnom Penh is the capital and most populous city of Cambodia. It has been the national capital since 1865 and has grown to become the nation's primate city and its political, economic, industrial, and cultural centre.

south-east-asia/phu-quoc.description: Phú Quốc is a special zone in An Giang province, Vietnam. It is the largest island in Vietnam. The island has a total area of 575 km2 (222 sq mi) and a permanent population of approximately 179,480 people in 2020.

south-east-asia/phuket.description: Phuket is one of the southern provinces (changwat) of Thailand. It consists of the island of Phuket, the country's largest island, and another 32 smaller islands off its coast.

south-east-asia/sentosa-island.description: Sentosa Island, known mononymously as Sentosa, is an island located off the southern coast of Singapore's main island.

south-east-asia/vang-vieng.description: Vang Vieng is a city in the Vientiane Province of Laos. It is popular with tourists, specifically backpackers, seeking adventure sports as well as its karst topography.

south-east-asia/yogyakarta.description: Yogyakarta is the capital city of the Special Region of Yogyakarta in Indonesia, in the south-central part of the island of Java.
